scope: fMoW-Sentinel clean 30k metadata, test split, macro-functional superclass extension
decision_principle: Axis roles are assigned from metadata-only support feasibility. No superclass-specific model predictions, losses, GeoBWER values, confidence intervals, or model-comparison outcomes are used.

support_contract.fixed_universe: observed geography levels in test x all eight pre-registered superclasses

region_superclass.required_wording: Supported-cell Region x Superclass analysis covering 87.1% of test samples and 45.2% of the fixed cell universe.
region_superclass.reason: Sample coverage is high enough for a useful secondary supported-universe analysis, but fewer than half of fixed-universe cells have descriptive support and only six cells meet the 30-site threshold.

country_superclass.required_wording: Sparse Country x Superclass audit-capability analysis; supported-cell findings cover 36.9% of test samples and must not be generalized to the fixed country-superclass universe.
country_superclass.reason: Only 3.5% of fixed cells have descriptive support and one cell meets the 30-site threshold, so this axis cannot sustain a main confirmatory fairness claim.

high_support_region_cell_panel.selection_rule: All and only region_superclass cells with at least 20 samples and at least 30 independent sites.
high_support_region_cell_panel.representativeness: Not representative of the complete Region x Superclass universe; concentrated in mobility_logistics and recreation_culture_landmarks.
allowed_analyses: Cell-level risk estimates with simultaneous confidence intervals
DOFAv2 versus ResNet-50 common-support paired cell-risk differences
Panel-level sensitivity summary with the six-cell scope stated explicitly

country_high_support_reference.reason: A single supported cell has no peer set from which to identify a country-superclass disparity or tail distribution.

analysis_requirements: Use the identical frozen taxonomy and cell universe for every model.
Use common-support paired model comparisons; do not compare models over different eligible cells.
Report fixed-universe cell coverage, test-sample coverage, zero-support cells, and excluded deployment mass with every supported-universe result.
Use site-aware or simultaneous confidence intervals for high-support cell comparisons.
Retain fixed-universe partial bounds or capability diagnostics rather than silently dropping unsupported cells.
Do not lower support thresholds, alter superclass membership, or replace the clean metadata after inspecting model outcomes.
next_step: Run the frozen same-metadata, same-split, three-seed fMoW ResNet-50 campaign; then compute DOFAv2-ResNet common-support paired comparisons under this axis-role freeze.
